counting: 301 Windows / 308 Linux reported cases in eight targets per platform, six default ignores each. Platform repetitions, preliminary Cargo runs, crash child scenarios and direct-image verification repetitions are not extra distinct cases. No real mounted or performance qualification rerun in this stage.
implementation: SavePool captures exact root and clones the registered worker SyncStorePool, or creates a bounded-idle standalone pool for a headless caller. Clone shares the same Arc and eight-idle limit. Four save workers and 64 outstanding operations still bound producers/preparation/publication; no new worker or larger queue.

Committed checkpoint/receipt lookup, checkpoint selection, publication transaction and continuation use deadline-owned zero-timeout secondary checkout outside Engine. Busy acquisition polls request cancellation/deadline; existing FULL WAL, capture validation, transaction progress handler, durable receipts and rollback quarantine remain unchanged.

Short Engine acquisitions fence stop/switching, exact root, active intent branch and checkout generation before secondary work and observation. They reject quarantined primary or an existing caller transaction; secondaries cannot escape that transaction. A fenced receipt explicitly advances EngineVitals.store_revision because primary total_changes cannot see a secondary commit, invalidating the existing status cell without SQL. Event delta/after_activation/observation publication remains under Engine after durable commit. Headless/mount/legacy-session guard remains enforced.

Panic/failed rollback on a save secondary cannot poison Engine or return the failed transaction to its shared pool. Lost reply retains private Saved/pending and retries the same metadata receipt, pinned content and continuation/adoption contracts. Different active branch refuses before refresh/adoption.
qualification: Six new executor parents: actual event-written transaction stalled1000ms while independent Engine read/private write/second enqueue remain live; external BEGIN IMMEDIATE and200ms deadline retain Saved then retry; actual publication panic rolls back without poisoning Engine; real SQLite authorizer denies ROLLBACK on a seeded shared-pool connection, which is quarantined/closed and fresh retry succeeds; committed old-branch receipt cannot refresh/adopt after branch checkout; caller primary transaction is refused with Saved retained and retry after explicit rollback succeeds. Existing group64, concurrent writes/adoption, bounded queue/shutdown, exact journal ownership, lost-reply and actual process-exit recovery parents rerun. Eight unchanged final executable hashes captured and directly executed without any compilation, checked before/after each and at completion; source manifest rechecked.
compatibility: No schema/canonical/wire/event changes. Private journal user_version4. No live activation/migration/mount or CAS deletion.
not_qualified: Native COW mounted write/read/truncate/close/flush/fsync integration, durable namespace/create/delete/rename/atomic replacement/open handles, startup recovery/retry and quiet/checkout/shutdown/status integration remain incomplete. Headless notification capture is None; mounted notification correctness is not claimed.

This removes save-specific metadata SQL/writer waits/FULL commits from Engine, not all runtime metadata operations. Existing legacy primary metadata mutations may themselves still hold Engine waiting for SQLite; current proof covers independent readonly metadata and other private writes. Short observation metadata reads remain under Engine.

Compatible metadata batching, automatic close-producer grouping, private journal mutex across FULL fsync, complete retention/root/deletion/GC/storage progress, whole-runtime budgets/fairness/shutdown/soak, WP6.5/6.6 and every original Wave6 release/build/platform/ENOSPC/power-loss/outage/physical amplification/compatibility/activation/handoff gate remain required.
development: Initial Windows check found SyncStorePool lacked Clone; derive Clone now shares the existing Arc. Review during preliminary regression qualification identified primary total_changes cannot observe a secondary publication. Explicit fenced store_revision invalidation and an assertion were added before final freeze. Preliminary in-flight compiles can contain earlier inputs and are diagnostic only, never attributed to final source or added to final totals.

An inline WSL bash command completed its test output but lost the shell variables used for exit recording (unary-operator diagnostic, empty exit file). It is retained as uncaptured-exit diagnostics, not final CLI evidence. A saved Bash runner captures each exit explicitly. Its first non-login invocation lacked Cargo on PATH (127); the final login-shell runner successfully finds the existing toolchain. No source or assertion changed for these harness corrections; repetitions are not extra passes.
